name: hacknation-template
description: Skrypty pomocnicze. Backend i frontend to osobne pakiety (własne package.json i bun.lock).

scripts.lint: bun --cwd=backend run lint && bun --cwd=frontend run lint
scripts.format: bun --cwd=backend run format && bun --cwd=frontend run format
scripts.format:check: bun --cwd=backend run format:check && bun --cwd=frontend run format:check
scripts.typecheck: bun --cwd=backend run typecheck && bun --cwd=frontend run typecheck
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run test:backend && bun run check:circular
scripts.scrape:ncbr: docker compose --profile dev exec backend-dev bun run scrape:ncbr
scripts.scrape:ppm: docker compose --profile dev exec backend-dev bun run scrape:ppm
scripts.scrape:baztol: docker compose --profile dev exec backend-dev bun run scrape:baztol
scripts.scrape:epo: docker compose --profile dev exec backend-dev bun run scrape:epo
scripts.scrape:uprp: docker compose --profile dev exec backend-dev bun run scrape:uprp
scripts.scrape:pbn: docker compose --profile dev exec backend-dev bun run scrape:pbn
scripts.scrape:pan: docker compose --profile dev exec backend-dev bun run scrape:pan
scripts.scrape:interreg: docker compose --profile dev exec backend-dev bun run scrape:interreg
scripts.scrape:all: docker compose --profile dev exec backend-dev bun run scrape:all
scripts.analyze: docker compose --profile dev exec backend-dev bun run analyze
scripts.pipeline: docker compose --profile dev exec backend-dev bun run pipeline
scripts.cron: docker compose --profile dev exec backend-dev bun run cron
scripts.cron:detached: docker compose --profile dev exec -d backend-dev bun run cron
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose --profile dev exec backend-dev bun run db:migrate
